comment: Areas of road data (#14). Each area is its own build, published in its own Release, with its own cells.json; the app reads the index (Release routing-index, areas.json) and picks the area that covers the ride. Italy (id it) is still built by routing-data.yml from routing-data.json into the routing-data Release, untouched, so older app versions keep working; it is listed here only for the index. Every other area is built by routing-areas.yml, on demand. bbox = lon min, lat min, lon max, lat max: a sanity check for the build (every cell must touch it). poly: outline of the extract (Osmosis .poly); inside it the data is complete, and the app prefers the area whose outline holds every stop.
